kernel_gate.oracle: Independent CPU binary64 numerical stable sort over fp32 inputs and p; math.fsum normalizer and certified compensated prefix; lower token ID resolves exact ties.
criteria: baseline and patched each contain the sorted reference prefix
patched kept set is a canonical prefix
patched symmetric difference to reference is no greater than baseline per row
patched extra count is at most three or less than 0.005 times reference count per row
input fp32 bytes are unchanged around cloned kernel calls
retained output fp32 bits equal input and excluded output is exactly negative infinity; reject NaN and positive infinity
compensated prefix scan agrees with independent binary64 fsum boundary certification
kernel_gate.gate_policy: No adaptive thresholds, seeds, corpus, tolerance, or reruns; failure stops before weights. Exact equality is diagnostic, not an acceptance criterion.

restoration: Managed restoration required after the stopped candidate; verification pending in this draft.
